anchor.indexing: h_7 means the post-ReLU state after the seventh nonlinear layer; zero-based tensor layer index 6
anchor.injection: replace the learned residual state at h_7 by the exact target-minus-host residual at h_7, once; all layers after h_7 are autonomous
anchor.statistic: full width-1024 residual state (an oracle ceiling only; no target values enter any deployable estimator)

comparators.autonomous: the frozen checkpoint receives only its own preceding residual state at every layer
comparators.teacher_forced: the frozen checkpoint receives the exact preceding residual state at every corrected layer
comparators.single_h7_reset: the frozen checkpoint receives one exact h_7 residual reset, then rolls out layers 8:16 autonomously

decision.primary: record whether the single exact h_7 reset gives final MSE <1e-8
decision.secondary: report its fraction of the autonomous-to-teacher-forced MSE gap closed
decision.terminal_rule: run this one anchor only; do not choose another anchor from its result

hypothesis: if a feasible N=65536 Kerdock prefix at h_7 can supply the missing action-relevant state accurately enough, then one exact h_7 state reset should expose a final-error ceiling near the 8.208e-9 all-layer teacher-forced result

model.training: none; reuse the fixed final checkpoint without modification

rationale: h_7 was fixed before this metric because it is the latest anchor reachable by the cross-lane N=65536 structured-point budget and is the primary state requested by the partition-complete cumulant lane
